review_notes: I read the whole file. I also read the definition of fullParallelCount in Estimates/AdjustedProfile.lean and grepped its other uses. The file has no @[simp] attributes. Its only simp-interface candidate is fullParallelCount_filter, which unfolds a definition into a filter over occupiedCenterCells. That is a deliberate rewrite, applied explicitly with simp only [...] and simp_rw in two places, and it is not a canonical normal form. Adding @[simp] would expand the definition everywhere, and the sibling lemma fullParallelCount_actual_line and the transfer and negation lemmas in other files work with the unfolded or raw form. I found no cycle, no competing rules and no wrongly oriented rewrite. The remaining simp calls (simp only [T,...], simp for sum_const and card, simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]) are local and do not show an interface defect. I could not run Lean, so I cannot rule out fragility in the AC-normalising simpa only call, but nothing in the sources shows a problem.
